label: Aircraft
description: Generic jets, propeller planes, helicopters, balloons, airships, gliders, and fictional flying craft.
notes: Aircraft types belong here, independent of manufacturer, model, livery, occupants, or maneuver. vehicle.spacecraft owns orbital and interplanetary craft; vehicle.watercraft owns boats, while aircraft designed to land on water remain here. Values use bare type names, with gyrocopter and seaplane included under familiar names rather than duplicate synonyms. Real and preserved aircraft have no era or genre restrictions; speculative aircraft alone carry genre tags.
